name: Nora Williams
signout: Five-week-old with fever, currently well appearing. The ED sent cultures and is waiting. I would not disturb her unless something results.
correctDiagnosis: Febrile young infant with invasive bacterial infection
diagnosisChoices: Febrile young infant with invasive bacterial infection

onset.parent: The fever started this afternoon and reached 38.4 C rectally.
onset.nurse: Fever was confirmed in the ED.

feeding.parent: She is still feeding, but a little less vigorously.

behavior.parent: She is sleepier but wakes for feeds.

findings.default: Febrile but arousable infant with a strong cry and preserved interaction.
findings.deteriorating: Febrile, irritable infant who is less easily consoled.
findings.postTreatment: Arousable infant with improving heart rate after therapy.

findings.default: Warm extremities, capillary refill under 2 seconds, mildly dry lips.
findings.deteriorating: Warm extremities with tachycardia and capillary refill near 3 seconds.
findings.postTreatment: Perfusion remains adequate under monitored therapy.

findings.default: Anterior fontanelle is soft; tone is appropriate; no focal deficit.
findings.deteriorating: Fontanelle remains soft; subtle irritability is present without focal deficit.

orders.name: Review blood-culture collection details and time to positivity
orders.result: Single peripheral pediatric bottle; adequate volume documented; time to positivity 16 hours; preliminary gram-positive cocci. These data raise concern but do not alone determine pathogen versus contaminant.

orders.name: Catheterized urinalysis and urine culture
orders.result: Urinalysis is not strongly suggestive of urinary infection; culture remains pending.

orders.name: Lumbar puncture with CSF studies
orders.result: CSF shows pleocytosis with elevated protein; Gram stain is negative and culture is pending.

orders.name: Empiric parenteral antibiotics
orders.result: Parenteral antibiotics have started after cultures.

orders.name: Admit for monitored parenteral therapy
orders.result: Nora is admitted with clear ownership of pending culture and CSF management.
